#include <jwt.h>
#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

using json = nlohmann::json;

std::string decode_json_web_token(const std::string& token, const std::string& key) {
    try {
        // Decode the JWT using HS256 algorithm
        auto decoded = jwt::decode<jwt::hs256>(token, key);
        // Convert the decoded claims to a JSON string
        json claims = decoded;
        return claims.dump();
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        // Return an empty JSON object string if decoding fails
        return "{}";
    }
}
```

Initial Solution: ```cpp
#include <jwt.h>
#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

using json = nlohmann::json;

std::string decode_json_web_token(const std::string& token, const std::string& key) {
    try {
        // Decode the JWT using HS256 algorithm
        auto decoded = jwt::decode<jwt::hs256>(token, key);
        // Convert the decoded claims to a JSON string
        json claims = decoded;
        return claims.dump();
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        // Return an empty JSON object string if decoding fails
        return "{}";
    }
}
